items.title: Sammy Penn Interview, 1960-04-21
items.q: Well I heard it, the band I heard it from was Sharky.

ctx.x: Baby told me he didn't hear it down here at all or even in Chicago only when he went to New York in the 40's that he first heard anybody do that. I wondered if you know, did you hear that before the war?
Well I heard it, the band I heard it from was Sharky. Sharky?
